pipeline: L1: MOMENTUM-ETF screener (live, sorted by 3M performance) → L2: LuxAlgo 3 screeners on 1W (hard filter: BOS + Bullish/Strong Bullish S&O Rating + ▲/▲+ Signal) → L3: NW Envelope per-symbol check (price inside bands = room to run, price above upper band = extended/wait)

nw_position_rules.inside: Room to run — valid entry candidate if R:R ≥ 1.5
nw_position_rules.extended: Price above NW upper band — do not enter, wait for weekly pullback
nw_position_rules.below_lower: Price below NW lower band — avoid

long: Symbol passed L2 hard filter (lux_screener_scan output: score ≥ 0)
NW position = inside (price between lower and upper band)
R:R ≥ 1.5: reward = NW upper band minus current price, risk = current price minus NW lower band

exit_criteria.stop_loss: Below NW Envelope lower band on the weekly. ETFs allow wider stops due to weekly timeframe.
exit_criteria.take_profit_1: Scale out 1/3 when price touches upper NW Envelope band on weekly.
exit_criteria.take_profit_2: Trail remaining via weekly 9 EMA. Exit if price closes below it for 2 consecutive weeks.

risk_rules: Do not enter if NW position = extended
Maximum 2 open ETF positions (one sector ETF covers 30+ stocks)
asset_notes: Sector and thematic ETFs on the weekly timeframe. Pipeline: MOMENTUM-ETF screener (3M performance sort) → LuxAlgo 3 screeners (BOS + Bullish rating + ▲ signal hard filter) → NW Envelope extension check. Top screener names typically: SOXX/SMH (semis), XLK/VGT (broad tech), CIBR (cybersecurity), SPMO/MTUM (momentum factor). BOS on a sector ETF = institutional rotation confirmed across the whole sector.
